blurb: In a silent village where no one dreams, a single lantern hums under the moonlight. What happens when you light it again?

S01.text:
[Echoes Beneath the Lantern — S01]

This is intentionally long test text for VerseCraft’s panel harness. Its job is to force the narrative region to scroll while keeping the page itself locked. Readability matters less than volume here: we want multiple paragraphs, punctuation, and line breaks.

The air tastes like iron and dust. Somewhere behind the UI frame, the world keeps moving—embers lift, shadows shift, and distant thunder rolls with a steady, patient rhythm. Your attention stays on the parchment: the words should remain inside the frame, never pushing the screen into a full-page scroll.

If you see this text extend beyond the narrative window without scrolling, the container sizing is wrong. If the whole screen scrolls, the page lock is wrong. If the choice labels wrap and look double-spaced, the pill clamp rules need tuning.

Keep going. Add more text. Add more lines. Add more words. We’re stress-testing the layout so later, real story prose and media can slot in cleanly.

Final paragraph: iOS Safari is picky about viewport height. This is why we use modern viewport units (dvh) and isolate scrolling to the narrative element only.
